description: 대구도시개발공사_도로건설사업현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대구도시개발공사. 본 데이터는 대구도시개발공사에서 추진 중이거나 완료한 도로건설사업의 세부 현황을 체계적으로 관리하고 대외적으로 공개하기 위해 구축된 공공데이터로, 도시 기반시설 확충과 관련한 사업. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
